messages.body: Canonical repository is now pdbsy/quantpass-arbitrum-hackathon. Existing Macbeth01–05 task directories have independent canonical checkouts. Old source worktrees and PRs remain preserved; do not continue publishing AlphaForge work to the old repository. This migration PR preserves source authorship, target engineering controls and protected user UI. Worker self-confirmation on the new repository remains unverified; this notice does not assign new work. No merge, deployment, transaction broadcast, mainnet or real funds are authorized.
